title: The Override Gap: A Magnitude Account of Knowledge Conflict Failure in Hypernetwork-Based Instant LLM Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2604.23750v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hypernetwork-based methods such as Doc-to-LoRA internalize a document into an LLM's weights in a single forward pass, but struggle when the document contradicts pretraining knowledge. We study this override gap through the competition between the pretrained answer margin and the shift induced by the generated adapter. On 194 Gemma conflicts, baseline accuracy falls from 65.3% in the weakest-prior quartile to 16.3% in the strongest. We introduce two training-free methods: Selective Layer Boosting (SLB), which scales the adapter at its highest-activity layers, and Conflict-Aware Internalization (CA), which chooses between standard and stronger adaptation using a short base-model probe. Strong boosting raises Gemma deep-conflict accuracy from 46.4% to 71.0%, with conflict gains also observed on Mistral-7B and Qwen-4B. Matched-norm controls show that both update magnitude and allocation matter: SLB benefits from the generated layer

translated_title: 覆盖鸿沟：基于超网络的即时LLM适应中知识冲突失败的幅度解析
translated_abstract: 基于超网络的方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）能够在单次前向传播中将文档内化到LLM的权重中，但当文档与预训练知识相矛盾时，这些方法表现不佳。我们通过预训练答案边际与生成的适配器所引起的偏移之间的竞争来研究这种覆盖鸿沟。在194个Gemma冲突样本上，基线准确率从最弱先验四分位组的65.3%下降到最强先验四分位组的16.3%。我们提出了两种无需训练的方法：选择性层增强（SLB），它在适配器活动度最高的层对其进行缩放；以及冲突感知内化（CA），它通过简短的基座模型探测在标准适应与更强适应之间做出选择。强增强将Gemma在深度冲突场景下的准确率从46.4%提升至71.0%，在Mistral-7B和Qwen-4B上也观察到了冲突增益。匹配范数的对照实验表明，更新的幅度和分配方式都很重要：SLB受益于生成的层...
tldr: 该论文揭示了基于超网络的即时LLM适应方法（如Doc-to-LoRA）在文档与预训练知识冲突时存在的“覆盖鸿沟”问题，并提出选择性层增强（SLB）和冲突感知内化（CA）两种免训练方法，将Gemma深度冲突准确率从46.4%提升至71.0%。
